chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.titan_ember: The ash has stopped. One beat sounded, a little late.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_one: ... The ash has come down another step. My grandmother used to say the key was one, long ago.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_thre: ... A strange tale. Only an old saying. If you carry all four, at least do not drop them.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_two: Not broken in four, she said. Entrusted to four places. A broken thing mends when gathered. A thing entrusted... one goes to return it, no?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.ch: What do you make of the key?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_one: I see it differently from the storyteller. I always thought a key was a tool for its bearer to choose with.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_thr: When you hold the fourth, I think you will know. Not what it opens, but what you were made to carry.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_two: Gather four and the door in the sky opens. I chased the whales believing that. But each one I gathered made my feet heavier. Not the key's weight.
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ember_heart: Found at the ash people's hearth. A few lines in a hand you almost know.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.aftermath.end: Far beneath your feet, a beat the same as the key's sounded once.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.aftermath.tel: ... Welcome back. Keep that key. It was we who kept looking only upward.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.ground: The soil underfoot is faintly warm. Only where the frost lay, a round patch has vanished.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.hum: The water in the pail is lukewarm. ... Far below, something low sounded once.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.ridge: The smoke of the far hill rises from a different place than yesterday.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.rise: The hill lifted. ... What you took for a mountain is breathing.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.hearth: The ruin of a hearth. The ash has been raked together in the shape of a hand.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.ledge: Only the stones of this ledge are warm, as if a hand had rested on them.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.post: Ash lies thin along the marks of the post. A little higher than yesterday.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.warm_base: Only the ground around your bed is warm.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.done: Their two tales held different ends of the same key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.isana.journ: Isana, too, wants to speak of the key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.summary: Hear about the key from the storyteller and from Isana, each in their own way.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.teller.jour: The ash mornings go on. The storyteller seems to want to talk about the key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.title: The Key That Was One
